user.title: Connect your U1
user.description: Enter only the local IP address of your Snapmaker U1. Moonraker is checked automatically. No PC bridge or YAML is needed. Unknown maintenance dates remain unknown.

auth.title: Printer authentication
auth.description: Moonraker requires an existing API key. The integration does not change printer firmware or disable authentication.

error.invalid_host: Enter only a private LAN IPv4 address, for example 192.168.1.50.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the U1. Check its power, IP address and local network.
error.unsupported: No usable Moonraker history was found on ports 80 or 7125.
error.invalid_auth: Moonraker did not accept this API key.

abort.already_configured: This IP is already configured. To change an existing address, use Reconfigure.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Connection updated. Maintenance records were preserved.

maintenance.title: Which maintenance did you complete?
maintenance.description: Each maintenance item has its own last event and next deadline. Intervals come from the official catalogue.

complete.title: {task}

reference.title: Initial reference (optional)
reference.description: Provide the commissioning date only if known. It is used for maintenance without a recorded event and does not certify an intervention. Existing maintenance events take precedence.

signal.title: XYZ calibration
signal.description: Report a calibration need after hotend/toolhead replacement, a bump, blob removal or visible multicolour misalignment. Record calibration after completing it.

counters.title: Fallback counters
counters.description: Optional: total toolhead swaps can be read from the U1 screen. They are never inferred from hours. Leave unused fields blank. Entering hours enables manual fallback; Resume automatic readings switches back. No intervals are required.

resume.title: Resume Moonraker readings
resume.description: Resume direct polling. If retained history was reset, accept the new counter as a new reference. Previous hour references are preserved separately. Dates and maintenance events remain intact.

data.confirm: Resume readings and accept a new counter reference if necessary

import_backup.title: Import maintenance records
import_backup.description: Optional. Paste a Companion 0.2.0 JSON export, or integration diagnostics containing maintenance_backup. This replaces current records after saving a local backup. The current IP and credentials are not changed. Backup notes may contain private information.

error.check_all_steps: Check all completed procedure steps before saving.
error.invalid_date: Invalid date, future date, or date earlier than the last recorded maintenance.
error.invalid_note: The note must contain at most 2,000 characters.
error.save_failed: Could not save. No new maintenance event was applied.
error.invalid_counter: Enter at least one valid counter without decreasing its previous value. Toolhead swaps must be integers.
error.invalid_backup: Invalid backup or incompatible catalogue. Current records were kept.
